newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND BANK GOVERNOR SEES NO ROOM FOR RATE CUT.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND BANK GOVERNOR SEES NO ROOM FOR RATE CUT.

text.p: Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen said on Wednesday that there was no room to cut the key Finnish tender rate.
Asked by a Reuters reporter whether there was room for a tender rate cut, Hamalainen said: "There is not."
Hamalainen declined comment when asked about signs that the central bank had recently intervened on the foreign exchange market to halt a sharp appreciation in the markka.
The Bank of Finland's tender rate -- its chief monetary policy tool -- has been unchanged since was lowered to 3.00 percent from 3.10 percent on October 9.
The tender rate is on par with the key German repo rate.
